data.title: 三司绫濑 · 够不到的钥匙
data.description: 钥匙掉到了柜子后面。绫濑蹲下查看，确认周围没人后，让它轻轻浮到自己伸出的手边。
data.action: reaching toward a key floating beside a cabinet
data.promptProse: Crouching cautiously in the secluded space between a wooden cabinet and an ivory wall, Ayase reaches out with a gentle, focused gesture as a metallic brass key hovers weightlessly in the air toward her fingertips. Faint, sparkling motes of telekinetic light shimmer around the key, while warm afternoon sunbeams cut through the dusty quiet of the room, casting delicate shadows across the floorboards.
